Bootstrap Token vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

MDM bootstrap-token marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Secure Token enablement — not a literal paste of US marketing:

引导令牌 (Bootstrap Token)

Enterprise MDM marketing uses 引导令牌 alongside the English term Bootstrap Token when describing MDM-escrowed credentials generated during ADE/DEP enrollment. AppLocale picks phrasing buyers recognize on each screenshot — an escrow dashboard needs 引导令牌-friendly headlines; a benefit line may keep Bootstrap Token when accurate to your English source.

安全令牌 (Secure Token)

US pages say "Secure Token" or "Enable Secure Token for mobile accounts." China storefront copy uses 安全令牌 or Secure Token when describing the macOS credential state Bootstrap Token escrow enables — distinct from 恢复密钥 Recovery Key and from consumer Passkeys vocabulary.

流动账户 / 网络账户 (mobile / network accounts)

Bootstrap Token enables Secure Token for mobile accounts or network accounts on Mac — accounts that log in via directory services rather than local-only users. zh-Hans copy often uses 流动账户 or 网络账户 on admin-console frames — not generic 用户账户 alone unless your gallery shows end-user UX.

MDM 托管 / escrow

Bootstrap Token must be escrowed by the MDM server before Secure Token enablement works — MDM 托管 or escrow on escrow-status dashboards. Do not conflate with 托管应用 Managed Apps app-install vocabulary unless your English source genuinely markets both on separate frames.

ADE/DEP Mac context

Bootstrap Token workflows are especially relevant on Automated Device Enrollment (ADE/DEP) Macs — 自动设备注册 or DEP Mac framing when your English source markets zero-touch enrollment fleets. This page stays on bootstrap-token escrow as lead — not full ADE enrollment marketing unless your gallery shows enrollment UI on separate frames.
